articles.title: GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights
articles.description: MIT researchers show that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can read and deliberately rewrite the weights of other AI models without traditional training. In one experiment, Astra boosted a Qwen model's math accuracy from 7.9 to 48.1 percent by changing just 0.016 percent of its weights. The approach could fundamentally simplify AI optimization but still hits clear limits. The article GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights appeared first on The Decoder.

articles.title: AI detects “invisible” signs of pancreatic cancer years before diagnosis
articles.description: A powerful new AI system could help doctors detect pancreatic cancer years before it becomes visible on conventional scans. The technology, called REDMOD, identified hidden warning signs an average of 475 days before diagnosis and was nearly twice as sensitive as experienced radiologists. By spotting cancer-related changes at their earliest stages, it could dramatically improve the chances of successful treatment for one of the deadliest forms of cancer.
